_doc: Bayesian network shared by all cases. Roots = candidate causes; CAP = low ground-storey capacity reserve (noisy-OR of M,X,D); INIT = local loss at ground storey (noisy-OR of A,F,CAP); CASC = cascade (high if CAP). Modes: base (INIT and CASC), blast, top, lat. Expert-elicited; edit and re-run.

labels.A: Loss or alteration of ground-storey load-bearing elements (removal, damage, cutting)
labels.M: Deficient materials / workmanship (low-strength concrete, poor steel)
labels.X: Extra storeys or loading beyond design (vertical extension, change of use, heavy plant)
labels.D: Design or detailing deficiency (undersized columns, weak ties)
labels.F: Foundation failure (bearing, settlement, expansive clay, excavation)

_calibration: cpt ['cap_D', 'cap_M', 'init_CAP'] set by leave-one-out calibration on validation/benchmark.json (2026-10-29); elicited values were {'cap_D': 0.5, 'cap_M': 0.6, 'init_CAP': 0.25}. See validation/README.md.
